title: Solitaire Table
pitch: A tactile single-player Klondike table with forgiving touch selection, clear legal-drop feedback and honest deal outcomes.
capabilities: Undo transactions and smooth card animation
rules: 52 unique cards; seven tableau columns; descending alternating-color sequences; foundations ascending by suit.
Draw-one and draw-three are explicit modes. Redeals use a documented policy. Legal move applies atomically before its visual tween.
Hints identify legal moves, not a guaranteed solution. Random deals are not labeled solvable. Victory only when all cards reach foundations.
content: One polished deck/backs, draw-one and draw-three, seeded deals and local move/time statistics.
